summary: Iteration 1 full-stack test of CostBridge. Backend: 22/22 core pytest cases pass (auth 401/403, role gating, crew/material planning incl. 409 double-booking, labor autofill/tolerance/absent/manual rate math, equipment DOWN reason + PM->special->CC->approved chain with Oracle payloads, material validation/consumed/cost/vs-plan/return_to_store, reject(min 3)/resubmit restart, own-entry 403, Setup stoppers + full auto-approval (restored), rate card/hour type edit, dashboard KPIs/filter, ERP not-configured 400s, users role change). 1 skipped (last-admin 409 untestable: 2 admins exist - cb.admin + krishna.adalath). Separate bug-repro suite: 5/5 confirmed bugs (see critical). Frontend (Clerk ticket sign-in per role): pending 'Awaiting access' + session persists on refresh, per-role sidebars, labor load-from-plan 4 rows / breach / absent / submit / manual cost, equipment reason gating + special flag, material errors + special + submit, approvals filters/flagged/review sheet/reject reason gating/approve, foreman Fix & resubmit with rejection reason banner, crew plan 409 toast, material plan cost total, dashboard filter, reports filter/CSV download/detail (approval chain, ERP lines, audit trail), ERP page disabled buttons + payload dialog, Setup save/persist, rate edit/persist/source toggle, users role change, mobile nav - all working.

critical.issue: Deleting rows that were loaded from plan still yields unmodified_from_plan=true (only remaining rows are checked) -> entry auto-skips Step 1 (or is fully auto-approved with auto_approval=full). Exception management bypass.

plan_line/planned_hours are trusted from the client; a manual entry with mode=plan, plan_line=true, planned_hours==hours and NO published plan is treated as unmodified -> auto-approval. Server must rebuild planned lines from the published plan (autofill logic) and compare; also require every plan line to be present.

Read-modify-replace without status guard: 4 concurrent approve calls at pending_step2 -> two 200s, duplicate approval entries and DUPLICATE cost_transactions (2 queued Oracle lines for a 1-line entry). Use find_one_and_update with {'id':..,'status':step} condition (same for reject).

Material plan line without planned_qty is accepted & publishable; afterwards every material preview/submit for that project/task/period returns 500 (KeyError 'planned_qty' in engine._tolerance_check). UI can trigger this (mplan qty left empty). Validate planned_qty > 0 on material plan lines.
Crew plan line without resource_number -> 500 KeyError in conflict check. Validate lines (resource_type+resource_number required, hours >= 0), and validate crew_id exists.

minor.issue: Negative planned hours accepted (hours dict values not validated ge=0/le=24).
Unknown resource_number / item_number accepted (rate_missing -> $0 cost) and submittable; should be 400 like unknown Project/Task.
Same employee can log 20h REG + 20h OT on one day (24h cap is per line only, no per-resource daily cap).
Any planner can edit a published plan (reverts it to draft, then deletable) even after entries were captured against it; no ownership check.
No endpoint to delete own drafts (draft LAB-00015 left over, tagged TEST_iter1).

Seeded material plan (CEM 400 BAG, REBAR 15 TON for current month) is far below seeded same-month consumption (3220 / 70), so every material entry on Civil-WBS-3 is a tolerance breach (+393%). Seeded labor budget for Civil-WBS-3 is also ~90% consumed, so 'unmodified plan -> pending_step2' only works once before the budget warning routes entries to Step 1.

ui_bugs.issue: Approver's own submissions are listed (e.g. PM sees LAB-00009 he submitted); clicking Approve only yields a 403 toast. Hide or mark 'your entry' and disable Approve.
For manual entries with no planned rows the Plan tolerance card shows 'Within tolerance - All planned rows are within tolerance' - should read 'No plan / unplanned'.
No delete button for draft plans in UI (API supports DELETE).

issues: Native <input type=date> browser picker used instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover
No explicit 'Sign out' button - only Clerk avatar menu
Button label 'Approve & Post' at step 2 is misleading - approval only queues cost lines; ERP push is a separate action

action_items: Server-side plan comparison: compute unmodified_from_plan from the published plan (all plan lines present, present=true, hours equal), never from client plan_line/planned_hours
Make approve/reject atomic with a status-conditioned find_one_and_update to prevent duplicate approvals & duplicate Oracle cost lines
Validate plan lines (material: item_number + planned_qty>0; crew: resource_type + resource_number, hours 0-24) and guard engine against missing planned_qty
Validate resource_number/item_number exist in master data on capture
Optional: per-resource daily hours cap; hide own entries in approval queue; fix 'Within tolerance' label for unplanned entries; delete draft plan/entry buttons
critical_code_review_comments: engine.validate: unmodified check iterates only submitted lines - must compare against plan line set
engine._tolerance_check: ln['planned_qty'] KeyError when plan line lacks qty (exclude_none drops it)
server.publish_plan: ln['resource_number'] KeyError; crew_id not validated
core._clerk_profile uses sync requests inside async dependency (blocks event loop on first sign-in) - minor

rca of the issue: Auto-approval bypass: validate() derives 'unmodified' purely from submitted lines' plan_line/planned_hours flags (client-controlled, and missing rows invisible). Duplicate costs: approve() reads tx, mutates in memory and replace_one's without a status precondition, so concurrent requests both pass the PENDING check. 500s: PlanLine model leaves resource_number/planned_qty optional and model_dump(exclude_none) drops them, while publish_plan/_tolerance_check index them directly.
